name: Create an activity risk plan
short_description: Produce a risk plan covering at least five hazards, controls, triggers to stop, and emergency actions.
self_assessment: I can create a five-hazard activity risk plan without help and state when the activity must stop.
description: Produce a risk plan covering at least five hazards, controls, triggers to stop, and emergency actions. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Plan controls for a community activity
